dedupe_keys.name: parameter estimation of an electrochemistry based lithium ion battery model using a two step procedure and a parameter sensitivity analysis

description: TU Eindhoven publishes data and simulation files for two-step parameter estimation and sensitivity analysis of an electrochemistry-based lithium-ion battery model. The native description specifies MATLAB 2017a. It lists concentration and potential outputs together with terminal voltage. Some MATLAB files reuse a one-dimensional coupled electrochemical and thermal battery model developed by Lu in a 2013 Ohio State bachelor thesis. The release contents and related resources follow the native description above. Coverage: The reviewed metadata does not establish a complete common temporal interval. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData descriptive metadata identifies this release. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The release is recorded as a model bundle with accompanying estimation data. The instruction document and scripts were not opened. Rights compatibility for reused code, parameter identifiability and simulation accuracy were not independently established.
